page_title: Image to Image AI – Free Photo Remix Editor | RemixThatPhoto

sources.entry: RemixThatPhoto - Edits a photo from a reference image or a written instruction for targeted changes. #freemium

summary.name: RemixThatPhoto
summary.one_liner: A web-based image-to-image AI editor that remixes an uploaded photo from a short written direction, using one of six targeted modes.
use_cases: Turn a photo into a painting or sketch
Remove a passer-by or sign from a photo
Move a product or person to a new background
Try a different outfit or jacket on a photo
Restore scratches and fading in a scanned print
Preview a new hair color on your own photo
summary.what_it_does: RemixThatPhoto takes one JPG, PNG or WebP photo (up to 30 MB) and a short written direction, then returns an edited image that keeps the subject and layout while changing what was asked. Users pick one of six modes: Restyle, Remove Object, New Background, Change Clothes, Enhance or Restore Old Photo. Output sizes are Standard (1 MP), Detail (2 MP) and Large (4 MP). The editor lets you compare the result side by side with the original before downloading. The page says edits usually take 20 to 40 seconds and that results have no watermark.
notable: Six focused edit modes, each targeting one kind of change
Three free Standard edits per UTC day with no sign-up and no watermark
Credit packs that never expire, plus monthly and yearly subscriptions
caveats: Larger output sizes (Detail, Large) and most edits require paid credits; a Standard edit uses 5 credits
Remove Object is the hardest mode and works best with exactly one named object
Does not promise a perfect likeness and is not a full manual editor like Photoshop; you must have rights to uploaded photos
